saving.title: Who can see the places I save?
saving.body:
New places are private by default. My map shows your own saves, while Discover lets you explore other people’s places.

Saving someone else’s place to your map does not copy their private notes or visit history.
saving.hint: Private notes, tags, visits, and folders are separate from public descriptions. Check a place’s visibility before making it public.

search.title: I cannot find a place
search.body:
Check the selected region first. Choose a broader region or all of Korea, then search with part of the place name or address.

Branches can have similar names. Check the address and region before saving.
search.hint: Demo mode only searches example places in Seoul, Busan, and Jeju. Search across real restaurants is not connected yet.

sharing.title: How do public maps and shared links differ?
sharing.body:
Other people can find a public map through Discover. A link-only map can be viewed by anyone with its link.

A regional share contains the places selected when it is created. Places you save later are not added automatically.
sharing.hint: Recipients can pass a link to someone else. In demo mode, shares are drafts on this device only; no working share link is issued.

account.title: I need help with my account
account.body:
For an email login, choose password reset on the sign-in screen if you forget your password. If you joined with Google or Apple, use the same sign-in method.

Find sign-out, record export, and account deletion information in Profile. Signing out and deleting an account are separate actions.
account.hint: Email delivery and sign-in require a configured authentication service in this development version. The deletion screen provides information; actual account deletion is not connected yet.

report.title: I found a problem with a map or place
report.body:
Open someone’s map in Discover to find profile and individual place reporting options. Check the target, choose a reason, and add details before reviewing the report.

In demo mode, blocking hides a person from Discover. You can unblock them in Profile.
report.hint: The report screen currently supports writing and reviewing. Report submission and moderator handling are not connected yet.

demo.title: Where are my demo records saved?
demo.body:
Demo mode lets you explore the app with example places. Saves and edits stay on this device and do not sync to a real account or another device.

Clearing app data or reinstalling may erase those records. Export anything you need from Profile first.
demo.hint: Demo places and profiles are examples. They do not represent real restaurant information, published maps, working share links, or submitted reports.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.recordsBody: Save places and organize them with notes, visit status, and folders. This guide explains how to use the current app.
terms.communityBody: Write public descriptions separately from private notes. Check that your public content respects other people’s privacy and rights.
terms.changesBody: The approved official document will explain minimum age, terms of use, account restrictions and closure, and policy changes. This feature guide does not define those conditions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.privateBody: Private notes, tags, visit history, and folders are kept separate as your own records. Use public descriptions for information you want other people to see.
privacy.sharedBody: Review each place’s visibility and the places you select to share. Public maps and link-only maps have different audiences. Demo mode does not publish maps or share them externally.
privacy.controlBody: The approved Privacy Policy will explain collected data, purposes, retention, processors and transfers, and how to exercise your rights. This guide does not establish the actual data processing terms.
